entries.reason: Owner-qualified registry handles survive dense swap-pop without retaining agents or providers.
entries.create: Registry maps generation-qualified identities to dense SOA slots; owner epoch is non-reused.
entries.ownership: Crowd owns agents; AgentRef is an unowned identity value and cannot keep the provider alive.
entries.destroy_order: Agent removal and clear invalidate generations. Crowd lifetime witness expires on destruction without retaining its owner; RTS checks before dereference, invalidates projections and reports unavailable. RTS destruction first removes owned projections.
entries.restore: In-process snapshot restoration allocates fresh owner identity and invalidates prior handles; consumers rebind stable names. Persistent format and migration remain unimplemented.
entries.stale: Check owner, occupied registry index and generation before resolving dense index.

entries.reason: Opaque leases pin immutable navigation storage, with owner/input/generation checks independent of provider lifetime.
entries.create: Completed owning plans publish one canonical input/surface/goals/algorithm entry; ready lookup shares its non-reused generation.
entries.ownership: Crowd owns cache metadata; leases retain only immutable field storage and an explicit pin, never the provider.
entries.destroy_order: Provider first: retained field remains safe but cannot bind another owner. Lease first: pin is released and deterministic byte-budget eviction may remove the unleased entry.
entries.restore: In-process checkpoint captures cache/agent lease values. Restore renews owner, retargets agent leases, and invalidates external old-owner leases. No persistent schema or cross-process handles.
entries.stale: Owner, navigation input epoch and algorithm version are checked before query/binding/Flow drive; latest physical geometry still owns wall solving.

entries.reason: CPU crowd movement has an explicit simulation and scripting boundary; authoring satellites are separate modules.
evidence: docs/dev/群体行为与流场模块设计.md
protocol: Process-local crowd.flowRequest token schema 1: exact integer owner/index/generation, required kind, unknown schema rejected and extra fields ignored. Tokens are transient and invalidated on restore; no persistent migration claim.

Per-agent MovementBinding selects an exact movement-class identity and revision. Zero/zero explicitly retains compatibility; imported Flow rejects missing/stale classes and radius mismatches observably. Values survive in-process snapshot, not a persistent schema.

Navigation input epoch is independent of default-field goal/publication revisions. Requests on one immutable input remain valid across other goal publications; geometry/cost/projection changes invalidate them. Both epochs are checkpointed in-process, not persistent schema.

Native immutable FlowLease cache, max 10000 entries, byte budget on retained vector capacities/resource metadata. Complete goal coordinates, input epoch, surface/class/cost provenance and algorithm version compare exactly. Last acquisition simulation tick and stable full key order evict only unleased entries. No new script lease protocol.

Existing generation-qualified flowRequest token can own one native lease after completed acquisition. releaseFlowRequest/restore releases that pin; sample checks token and native input epoch. No independent script lease identity yet.

Script updateAgents accepts flowRequest or explicit useDefaultFlow. Shared raw token resolver never invokes delegates; malformed/stale bindings reject atomically. Request release drops its pin without detaching agent-owned copies.

Sparse broadphase owns numeric slots, signed-int64 row/cell keys and canonical tie order. maxGridCells caps occupied cells; optional exact-integer maxSpatialVisits caps row/cell enumeration plus binary comparisons. Grid entries/sort comparisons/spatial visits are owning report fields; no skipped contacts on exhaustion, advance rollback invalidates the derived index. No new persistent schema.

Contact candidates use count/prefix allocation before fill, canonical tie-pair sorting, independently owned pair deltas and per-agent incident CSR gather in pair order. Optional exact integer maxContactPairs bounds live entries per pass (0..10000000, default 1000000); maxPairVisits bounds scratch-init/count/prefix/fill/sort/delta-init/incident-gather work. Capacity/work exhaustion rolls back advance, never truncates contacts. contactPairsPeak/pairVisits are owning diagnostic fields; CSR contains N+1 offsets and exactly 2P indices bounded by pair capacity; rollback/restore invalidates deltas and incidents. Serial and injected parallel execution share 256-item logical partitions and pair/gather mathematics. Joined provider failure rolls back advance without rerun. Snapshot does not retain a scheduler; restore preserves current execution configuration. No persistent schema.

Crowd::setWorkScheduler is native composition-root configuration, deliberately not script-bindable; Parallel without a shared adapter rejects. One known provider, high-frequency dispatch and mandatory stage join select direct injected interface, never capability lookup on the hot path. Velocity acceleration/predictive scoring/heading and contact delta/gather dispatch through the same fixed partitions. Preferred Boids/seek/wander math also dispatches; owner prepares complete bounded neighbor CSR and owning Flow numeric samples before workers. Prediction neighbors are owned per agent (at most maxNeighbors+1 active entries during bounded selection; storage may retain historical capacity); owner preflights the exact score count before dispatch. No worker writes counters or queries the mutable broadphase.

Predictive scoring count is derived from the same angle/fraction arrays used by the kernel (currently 45 scores per selected neighbor). Held/zero-speed rows have no predictions. maxPredictionChecks rejects before dispatch; rollback/restore invalidates per-agent prediction scratch. No new persistent schema or clock authority.

Optional exact-integer maxPreferredNeighbors (default 1000000, allowed 0..10000000) bounds complete force-neighbor entries per substep; maxPreferredVisits charges velocity workspace, count/prefix/init/fill, Flow samples and force entries before dispatch. Underlying query/comparison work remains charged to maxNeighborVisits/maxSpatialVisits. No force truncation on exhaustion. preferredNeighborsPeak/preferredVisits are owning native and both script report fields. Original conservative query radius and float force-boundary semantics are preserved. navigationField raw borrow remains owner-only, never crosses a task; workers consume three owned numeric Flow values. Rollback/restore invalidate CSR/Flow samples. This does not complete all prediction-preparation cost, tile layers or battle performance acceptance.

Canonical prepareAgentUpdates owns copied values and non-reused owner identity, rejects duplicates/invalid/stale/foreign leases, and retains no caller span, numeric slot or provider pointer. commitAgentUpdates validates all references and optional zero/one selection before mutation, resolves compaction at commit, consumes the move-only token only on success and allocates no success-path workspace. Empty selection applies all; stale unselected references reject the whole plan. Provider-first destruction is safe; restore invalidates old-owner tokens. Native composition API only, not a second script token identity. updateAgents is a documented compatibility-only facade over the same canonical inward path. No persistent schema. OBJECT process allocation probe injects one actual preparation allocation failure and counts zero allocations for selected commit after a motion step.
entries.thread_affinity: Crowd owner dispatches; avoidance workers read frozen positions, interactions and spatial directories, write disjoint per-agent neighbor lists and partition-local work counters, then join before deterministic counter merge. Contact workers read frozen numeric columns and write partition-owned delta/correction slots. No public Crowd access concurrently or callback reentry.

trim.evidence: crowd-core-only selects common/crowd and squirrel; Windows Debug SHARED eve_crowd_check passes 60 cases with host off. EVFoundation.dll imports only Windows/C++ runtime DLLs. OBJECT crowd+RTS+font composition passes 128 cases. Provider-absent startup of unrelated client profiles remains unverified.

cost_notes.why: Explicit checkpoint copies own runtime storage; restore allocates a one-use targeted plan before allocation-free publication and stale-reference invalidation.
Bounded integration and neighbor/contact iterations; report owns residual observations.
One world snapshot per caller-built batch and explicitly bounded placement/contact work before atomic publication.
Numeric validation and bounded owning frame copies amortize synchronization per phase; no implicit spatial rebuild.
Copies positions once and validates bounded exact placement before resetting velocities atomically.

Prepare copies owned workstate. Advancement spends deterministic heap-pop and direction-cell units; stale source revisions cancel before work. Commit publishes only completed state with noexcept move assignment.

Owning map-adapter snapshot validates typed surface/movement provenance and separates raw physical costs from preinflated navigation costs. Preparation allocates and commit publishes with no allocation.
Ready lookup normalizes bounded goals; publication moves completed work after metadata/budget staging. Field pressure fails atomically without consuming the plan or default-field publication.
Allocate/copy/sort once before publication; later commit validates numeric identities and selection and applies values without success-path allocation.

entries.reason: Optional synchronous JobSystem adapter preserves core isolation, provider lifetime and joined failure atomicity.

provides.impl: JobScheduler (direct factory injection, not capability registry)
provides.absent_behavior: Explicit Parallel selection without a lease rejects; serial remains available.

requires.fallback: Expired or stopped provider returns failure before dispatch; no implicit serial execution.

protocol: No ECS/Link rows, events, script bindings or tool protocol. Numeric logical partition ids and borrowed native bodies are transient synchronous work, never persistent handles.

A genuine shared owner from createJobSystem owns the pool. Adapter stores weak ownership; dispatch locks it through submit and join. Caller must not stop the pool during dispatch. Release during flight is safe; release while idle makes subsequent dispatch fail. No no-op borrowed deleters.

Each callback exception is captured in a partition-owned slot because JobSystem join does not propagate child failure. All children join before Result failure; no serial retry or partially published Crowd step.
entries.thread_affinity: Composition root creates the lease; Crowd owner dispatches; native callbacks may run on workers or helping waiter without locks.

trim.evidence: L1/L2/L3: crowd-core-only host-off SHARED without satellite passes 114 cases; crowd-thread-core-only selects common/thread/crowd/crowd_thread only, builds Foundation/Platform DLLs and passes 117 cases. OBJECT and SHARED Crowd+RTS compositions each pass 216 cases. Logs build/crowd-scheduler-{core,trim,shared}-tests.log and build/crowd-scheduler-tests.log. No graphics/RTS/Map provider needed for trimmed runtime; no full release-performance or renderer claim.

cost_notes.why: One adapter allocation amortized across ticks; each dispatch allocates per-partition error/job storage and joins all work.
